description: The plot shows evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) for several model variants as the activated parameters ratio changes. The x-axis is labeled “Activated Parameters Ratio(%)” on a linear scale, displayed in decreasing order from 100 to 25, with tick marks at 100, 75, 50, and 25 (interval 25). The y-axis is labeled “Eval PPL.” on a linear scale, spanning roughly 11.5 to 14.0 with regularly spaced tick labels every 0.5. Four lines are shown: the “Transformer” series is a red dashed horizontal line staying near 11.6 across all x values; “Only MoHD FFN” is a gray solid line with square markers, near 11.5 at 100, about 11.5 at 75, dipping to about 11.3 at 50, then rising to about 11.8 at 25; “Only MoHD ATTN” is a dark line with circular markers, around 11.5 at 100, about 11.6 at 75, increasing to about 12.2 at 50, and reaching about 14.3 at 25; “MoHD ATTN + MLP” is a blue solid line with x-shaped markers, around 11.5 at 100, about 11.5 at 75, increasing to about 12.0 at 50, and reaching about 13.2 at 25. The legend appears in the upper-left of the plotting area.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates the evaluation perplexity (PPL) across varying ratios of activated parameters measured in percentage. The x-axis is labeled as 'Activated Parameters Ratio (%)' and ranges from 25 to 100 in reverse order, with tick labels at intervals of 25. The y-axis is labeled 'Eval PPL' with a linear scale from 11.5 to 14.0 and tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The red dashed line labeled 'Transformer' remains horizontal across the x-axis at a PPL of approximately 11.6. The gray line with square markers for 'Only MoHD FFN' starts at a PPL of about 11.5 at 100% activation, decreases slightly to a PPL of 11.2 at 50%, then rises again to approximately 11.8 at 25%. The purple line with circle markers for 'Only MoHD ATTN' starts at about 11.5, rises significantly to around 14.0 at 25%. The blue line with cross markers for 'MoHD ATTN + MLP' begins at 11.5 and follows an upward trend to approximately 13.8 at 25%. A legend is placed at the top left corner of the plot, indicating the methods compared.
